'''Oleg Klerren''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], a [[City/Legends|town]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had two aides named [[Cohn]] and [[Ixa]] assisting him with his duties. When Anchorhead was hit by a series of bombings that killed over a hundred of people, Oleg was glad to see [[Havoc Squad]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] arrive with help. They were contacted by a former Havoc Squad member, [[Vanto Bazren]], who told them that Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gorik]] was behind the bombings. Havoc Squad was able to stop Gorik and rescue Fuse, for which Oleg was extremely grateful.
